'''Swordbearer''' or, more completely, Swordbearer to the [[Throne of the Clouds]] is a [[Kandori]] title for the member of the royal court who, as the title implies, bore the monarch's sword, the [[Sword of Kirukan]].{{ref/book|8|p}}{{ref/book|14|28}}{{ref/book|Twotc|Baldhere, Lord}}

==Known Swordbearers==

* [[Baldhere]] - Swordbearer to Queen [[Ethenielle Kirukon Materasu]]{{ref/book|8|p}}
